models_evaluated: Llama3.2 with RAG (Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics)

links.outcome: Accuracy on pediatric multiple-choice questions with vs without retrieval grounding in Nelson Textbook
links.effect: RAG-integrated Llama3.2 achieved 67.78% (1,161/1,713) vs 46.18% (791/1,713) for standalone Llama3.2 (p = 1.5e-112); improvement consistent across pediatric subspecialties.
links.quote: The RAG-integrated system significantly outperformed standalone Llama3.2, achieving an overall accuracy of 67.78 % (1,161/1,713) compared to 46.18 % (791/1,713) for Llama3.2 alone (p = 1.5e-112).

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates whether adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using a standard pediatric textbook to an existing LLM (Llama3.2) improves accuracy and reduces hallucinations on pediatric clinical benchmark questions.
